title: Mittag-Leffler for punctured-spectrum cohomology towers
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\setminus\{\mathfrak m\}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For an $A$-module $N$ put $\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}(N)=\{x:\mathfrak m^r x=0\text{ for some }r\geq0\}$ and $H^j_{\mathfrak m}(N)=R^j\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}(N)$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor]. For every countable inverse system $(M_n)_{n\geq1}$ of finite $A$-modules [def-weil-inverse-system, def-weil-finitely-generated-module], the systems $H^j_{\mathfrak m}(M_n)$ are Mittag-Leffler for all $j\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-mittag-leffler-system]. For every countable inverse system $(\mathcal G_n)_{n\geq1}$ of coherent $\mathcal O_U$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], the systems $H^j(U,\mathcal G_n)$ are Mittag-Leffler for every $j>0$ [pqf-def-cohomology].
